description: We're ORBITRONS, a team of four B.Sc. IT students united by our love for space and games. We're beginners in technology, but not in thinking. Driven by curiosity, we're learning, experimenting and turning ideas into reality with the resources we have. Through Orbit Quest, we aim to make space exploration exciting and accessible while helping players appreciate the science and scientists behind every mission. For us, every great discovery starts with curiosity.
